day_shape: 66 items: IDF strikes Hezbollah sites around Tyre with evacuation warnings and one soldier killed, fresh OFAC SDN designation, Khamenei issues Ferdowsi-day cultural messages, Araghchi doubts US sincerity, UAE accelerates Hormuz-bypass pipeline.

threads.label: South Lebanon strikes and Hezbollah fire
threads.summary: The IDF launched airstrikes on Hezbollah infrastructure around Tyre after issuing evacuation warnings for villages including Ein Baale and Arab Salim, and intercepted a rocket fired at troops. Times of Israel reported one Israeli soldier killed by a Hezbollah mortar in south Lebanon, with explosive drones striking near the border and a launcher in Zebdine destroyed overnight.

threads.label: Hormuz, Gulf alignments and oil bypass
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported the UAE is accelerating a pipeline project to bypass the Strait of Hormuz, while Jerusalem Post reported the UAE urged Saudi Arabia and Qatar to coordinate strikes against Iran and that IDF Chief Zamir made a secret wartime visit to the UAE. IRIB cited Reuters and the Independent framing the strait as a lever in Tehran's hands, and reported Pakistan returned 20 Iranian crew from US-detained vessels.

threads.label: Iran nuclear diplomacy messaging
threads.summary: Defa Press quoted Foreign Minister Araghchi saying Iran doubts US sincerity, proposing enrichment be deferred, and telling Indian media there is no military solution. Defa Press also cited Al-Mayadeen diplomatic sources claiming China's position on Iran's nuclear programme and Hormuz is unchanged after Trump's Beijing visit, while IRIB amplified Al Jazeera and Foreign Policy commentary on Trump's options.

threads.label: Khamenei Ferdowsi-day cultural cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office released a Persian Language Preservation Day message invoking Ferdowsi, the Shahnameh and the 'third sacred defence', repeated by Defa Press and echoed by President Pezeshkian on IRIB. The cycle was paired with a Defa Press unveiling of a book titled 'Geometry of Conflict' compiling Khamenei statements on enmity with the 'arrogance'.

threads.label: Regime war-resilience and martyr messaging
threads.summary: Army Commander Hatami told Defa Press forces would stand 'until the last drop of blood', spokesman Shekarchi stressed winning the 'cognitive war', and the judiciary head praised public resource-saving. Defa Press announced a 27 Ordibehesht commemoration for the martyred defence minister and ministry personnel of the 'third imposed war' at Hazrat Abdol Azim Hasani in Ray.

threads.label: Iran domestic economic strain
threads.summary: Iran International reported fuel shortages and tighter rationing pushing Iranians into a gasoline black market with long queues and inflated prices. IRIB carried claims of 76 operational petrochemical complexes producing $24 billion annually and cited Le Monde on global aviation cost pressures, while Times of Israel reported Iraq is seeking IMF and World Bank assistance after war-related oil income losses.

threads.label: Western governmental and legal track
threads.summary: OFAC published a fresh Notice of Sanctions Action adding names to the SDN list, and the UK delivered a statement at the UN Security Council on Syria via Ambassador James Kariuki. Iran International reported a London arson trial concerning three defendants charged over an incident near its studios is set for 25 January 2027 at the Central Criminal Court, while Jerusalem Post reported the first Palestinian ICC filing seeking investigation of 14 Hamas leaders.

events.title_en: Foreign Policy account of American political structure's ineffectiveness: why Congress cannot stop Trump's war machine against Iran
events.summary_en: Foreign Policy account of American political structure's ineffectiveness: why Congress cannot stop Trump's war machine against Iran. Although war against Iran faces serious legal questions, the American political system is in a deadlock that has effectively removed Congress's deterrent power. Under the War Powers Act, the president has only 60 days to continue military operations without congressional approval; but the Trump administration claims that the temporary ceasefire of 8 April stopped the legal clock and the war is effectively 'over'. Although the Constitution gives Congress budget allocation power, the reality is that the US military continues with an unprecedented budget of 1 trillion.

events.title_en: Book 'Geometry of Conflict' unveiled
events.summary_en: Book 'Geometry of Conflict' unveiled. The book 'Geometry of Conflict; knowing the enemy and methods of countering it in the thought of the late Ayatollah Khamenei' will be unveiled this evening at a public gathering in Tehran's Revolution Square. This work is a collection of statements and directives from the deceased leader of the revolution regarding the nature of the enmity of the arrogance front, the methods of the enemy's propaganda and cultural warfare and strategies to counter it. In this book, through thematic categorisation of his statements, an attempt has been made to present a clear picture of the logic of the Islamic Revolution's confrontation with the system of domination and global Zionism.
